As mentioned earlier, the name is derived from the words 'manas' and 'isha,' signifying the ruler or god of the mind. In Hinduism, it is believed that the mind is the source of all thoughts and actions, and controlling the mind is crucial for achieving spiritual growth and inner peace. Therefore, the name Manesh holds the power to remind us of the importance of mental focus and discipline in our spiritual journey towards enlightenment.
